The awesome and reliable dbz news site Kanzenshuu has provided some leaked info about dragon ball super (http://www.kanzenshuu.com/2015/06/17/early-dragon-ball-super-story-details-in-august-2015-v-jump/))

The most important part seems to be that the show will begin pre-battle of gods, but will progress to ressurrection F and beyond. It appears to begin with a light hearted "slice of life tone," which I love! It's been a long time since dragon ball was on t.v, so taking time to reacquaint with the characters and see them relax is refreshing.

That being said I hope they don't take it easy for too long, or we may end up with a GT style backlash. My hope is that 3 or 4 episodes detail pre BOG, with plenty of lighthearted comedy and perhaps a bit of set up for future threats. Then move into post BOG with an action packed mini arc showing how Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan came to be and how/why Vegeta joins it's ranks. Then post RF a fully fledged arc, possibly exploring the other universes and upping the ante like never before.

TL;DR: Super excited about DB Super. New info is interesting, cannot wait. you?
